applies_to: Examples where PRO09 = 2 (No), PRO09 = 8 (Don't know) or PRO10 = Z (Yes, but don't know which). Examples that name a recommendation are kept as reported.

steps.question: Is the example about producing statistics, rather than delivering a programme such as cash, services or awareness?
What reason does the respondent give, if any?

other.label: Follows another framework (national law, EU Regulation 862/2007, UN migration recommendations)

unaware.label: Says they do not know the recommendations

deliberate.label: Says the recommendations were deliberately not applied

steps.question: What kind of example is it?
steps.note: Correct PRO08 when it does not describe the example, for example a training reported as administrative data.

steps.question: Can the populations be told apart as recommendation categories (refugees, asylum seekers, temporary protection, returnees, IDPs including disaster, stateless people)? For events: is the topic refugee, IDP or statelessness statistics?

admin.name: Administrative data or register
practice: The data reach the statistical office, by transfer or linkage
IRRS 214 · IRIS 263 · IROSS 268
They are published as statistics
IRRS 198 · IRIS 253

survey.name: Survey
practice: The sample reaches them: camps, reception centres, informal settlements, or oversampling where they live
IRRS 181, 187 to 188 · IRIS 239 · IROSS 207
The statistical office is involved in the design
IRRS 180 · IRIS 238

census.name: Census
practice: It covers camps, reception centres and collective accommodation
IRRS 140 · IRIS 215 · IROSS 171
It asks the reason for the move, with a forced displacement option
IRRS 132 to 133 · IRIS 213 to 214

integ.name: Data integration
practice: The linked source that holds the population is itself a register, survey or census that meets its checks
see that source
Records are linked with an ID number or a documented matching method
IRRS 243 to 252 · IRIS 284 to 290

strategy.name: Strategy or roadmap
practice: It involves the national statistical system
IRRS 520, 541 to 543 · IRIS 343 to 345 · IROSS 326

guidance.name: Guidance or toolkit
practice: It is written for producers of statistics
IRRS 609 · IRIS 386 · IROSS 370

nontrad.name: Non-traditional source
practice: It is used for a statistical purpose
IRRS 241 · IRIS 265 to 270 · IROSS ch. 5 D

items.text: Uses the recommendation categories by name: asylum seekers, refugees, temporary protection, returnees, IDPs (including disaster), stateless people
Identifies them the recommended way: citizenship, country of birth, year of arrival, reason for migration or displacement, or legal status in a register
Produces the recommended statistics: counts by category, or indicators on living conditions, integration, solutions or the SDGs
items.refs: IRRS 114, ch. 5 · IRIS ch. 4 to 5 · IROSS ch. 4

items.text: The topic covers refugee, IDP or statelessness statistics
The audience is statistical offices or a statistical body
The same organisation reported use for this example, the same source, or another example in this submission
Built on an instrument that follows the recommendations, such as the UNHCR Forced Displacement Survey or a MICS or DHS displacement module
EGRISS or an EGRISS member supported it, or the description mentions the recommendations

thresholds.note: q2 = other adds 1 point and counts as a sign of use for a No.

outscope.label: Keep the answer
outscope.detail: Not a statistics example. Flag for the example validity check.

deliberate.label: Keep the answer
deliberate.detail: They chose not to apply the recommendations. Record the reason.

outreach.label: Keep the answer, send outreach
outreach.detail: Send the relevant recommendation, offer training or e-learning, count as an awareness gap.

nocat.label: Keep the answer
nocat.detail: The populations cannot be told apart as recommendation categories.

edit.label: Edit and notify
edit.detail: Record as using the recommendation and email what changed and why, with paragraphs. They can reply if it is wrong.

fill.PRO10: recommendation of the category identified (refugees, asylum seekers, temporary protection, returnees: IRRS; IDPs: IRIS; stateless: IROSS)

aligned.label: Keep the answer, record as aligned
aligned.detail: Counts in the alignment figure, not in use.

recording.never_overwrite: PRO09 as reported is kept; changes go to PRO09_reviewed
recording.reporting: Report use as reported, use after review, and alignment separately. Exclude Secretariat-filled PRO12 from the elements-used table unless the respondent confirmed.
